Navantia, the Spanish state‑owned naval shipbuilder, has entered a strategic partnership with Multiverse Computing, an artificial intelligence consulting firm, to accelerate the development and deployment of AI technologies for naval defence applications.  The agreement combines Navantia’s maritime expertise with Multiverse’s advanced AI capabilities to enhance naval operations, weapon systems, and cyber‑defence.  The deal was announced through aggregated global news coverage by Google News.
